# Bullet Styling

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Bullet Styling

Let's take a look at all possible values of the list-style-type property.

```html
1<ul class="no-bullets">
2    <li>No bullet</li>
3</ul>
4<ul class="disc">
5    <li>Disc bullet</li>
6</ul>
7<ul class="circle">
8    <li>Circle bullet</li>
9</ul>
10<ul class="square">
11    <li>Square bullet</li>
12</ul>
```

```css
1ul.no-bullets {
2    list-style-type: none; /* Removes default bullets */
3}
4
5ul.square {
6    list-style-type: square; /* Adds square bullets */
7}
8
9ul.circle {
10    list-style-type: circle; /* Adds circle bullets */
11}
12
13ul.disc {
14    list-style-type: disc; /* Adds disc bullets */
15}
```

The list now has customized bullets, allowing for different visual styles.

Browser Output

![HTML List with Mixed Bullets](data:image/png;base64,)

Now that you know how to style your lists, let's explore how you can control the position of the bullets or numbers with the list-style-position property.
